Riley_CSM: Quick idea for PolarisPay renewal — run a conservative perf experiment: int8 quantized model + smart regional routing to warm pools. Target: ~20% median latency reduction and ~15% token cost saving. Renewal conversation mid-Q4. Thoughts?
Ethan_SE: Sounds good. PolarisPay flagged hallucination sensitivity last quarter. Recommend a 7% canary with automatic fallback to fp16 and capture 400 blind samples for quality check.
Priya_RE: Baseline metrics: median seq=140, p75=260, p95=700. Heavy window at 20:00 UTC. Current p50=232ms, p95=710ms. Will attach a short sample: ```json
{"20": {"reqs": 2400, "p50": 310, "p95": 720}}```
Riley_CSM: I'll confirm with the customer that we only surface sampled prompts and that rollback can happen within 30m. They want the exact sample list before pilot.
Ethan_SE: Canary config draft:
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.07
model_variant: polaris-v1-int8
fallback: polaris-v1-fp16
monitoring: [latency, error_rate, semantic_similarity]
sample_capture: true
abort_thresholds: {quality_delta_pct: 1.0, error_rate_increase: 0.5}
```
Ethan_SE: I'll run a synthetic replay for the 20:00 UTC distribution to validate p95 improvements. ETA 90m.
ops_bot: Deploy bot: initiating canary polaris-v1-int8 -> 7% traffic at 3241597542. Dashboard: canary/3241597530.
ops_bot: Canary update: 50m running, p50 down 18%, p95 down 11%, error rate steady. No regression alerts.
Finance_Bot: Estimated token cost delta at 7% mix: ~14% savings extrapolated, will confirm dollar impact after weekly billing run.
Riley_CSM: Great. Once blind eval finishes, we'll assemble a one-pager for renewal showing latency, cost, and sample-quality notes. Leaving action items: (1) Ethan share sample file, (2) Priya attach baseline slice, (3) I draft customer comms.
__notes: Short Slack thread coordinating a cautious int8 quant + routing canary for an at-risk renewal account. Includes code/config snippets and bot deploy updates.
